name: Five of Cups
shortMeaning: Five of Cups represents loss, disappointment, and the tender work of grieving what did not go as hoped.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Five of Cups says your emotions need compassion and room to mourn before they can fully turn toward what remains.
pathMeaning: On your path, Five of Cups points toward processing sorrow honestly while remembering that not everything valuable has been lost.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Five of Cups brings a blessing of emotional honesty, healing tears, and the strength to notice what can still be saved.

name: Six of Cups
shortMeaning: Six of Cups speaks of nostalgia, sweetness, memory, and the gentle pull of the past into the present.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Six of Cups says your feelings are touching old tenderness, innocence, or memories that still matter.
pathMeaning: On your path, Six of Cups points toward reconnection, kindness, and healing through simple gestures or familiar emotional truths.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Six of Cups brings a blessing of softness, reunion, and heartfelt reminders of what is genuinely good.

name: Seven of Cups
shortMeaning: Seven of Cups represents many possibilities, dreams, and the challenge of sorting fantasy from what can truly be chosen.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Seven of Cups says your emotions may be full of longing, imagination, or uncertainty about what you really want.
pathMeaning: On your path, Seven of Cups points toward discernment, clear priorities, and choosing substance over illusion.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Seven of Cups brings a blessing of imagination, intuitive vision, and the wisdom to choose what is real.

name: Eight of Cups
shortMeaning: Eight of Cups speaks of leaving behind what no longer fulfills you in order to seek something more meaningful.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Eight of Cups says part of you already knows a chapter is emotionally complete, even if walking away feels hard.
pathMeaning: On your path, Eight of Cups points toward release, emotional honesty, and the courage to move toward deeper truth.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Eight of Cups brings a blessing of clarity, clean departure, and guidance toward what nourishes you more deeply.

name: Nine of Cups
shortMeaning: Nine of Cups represents contentment, gratitude, and the pleasure of a heartfelt wish being fulfilled.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Nine of Cups says your feelings are ready to enjoy what is already good instead of only chasing what is next.
pathMeaning: On your path, Nine of Cups points toward fulfillment, self-appreciation, and trusting that pleasure can be part of your growth too.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Nine of Cups brings a blessing of sweetness, abundance, and a wish ripening in your favor.

name: Ten of Cups
shortMeaning: Ten of Cups speaks of emotional fulfillment, harmony, and the deep happiness of love and belonging.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Ten of Cups says your emotions long for peace, closeness, and a life that feels loving all the way through.
pathMeaning: On your path, Ten of Cups points toward lasting happiness, healed relationships, and choices that support true emotional wellbeing.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Ten of Cups brings a blessing of joy, family-hearted warmth, and the feeling of being deeply at home.

name: Page of Cups
shortMeaning: Page of Cups represents tenderness, intuition, and unexpected emotional messages or fresh feelings beginning to stir.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Page of Cups says your feelings are soft, curious, and asking to be approached with wonder instead of cynicism.
pathMeaning: On your path, Page of Cups points toward creative openness, heartfelt communication, and trusting gentle intuition.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Page of Cups brings a blessing of sweetness, synchronicity, and a lovely emotional surprise.

name: Knight of Cups
shortMeaning: Knight of Cups speaks of charm, romance, imagination, and following what moves the heart with sincerity.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Knight of Cups says your emotions want to move, express, and pursue what feels meaningful and beautiful.
pathMeaning: On your path, Knight of Cups points toward emotional honesty, creative action, and saying yes to what truly enchants you.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Knight of Cups brings a blessing of romance, inspiration, and graceful movement toward a heartfelt desire.

name: Queen of Cups
shortMeaning: Queen of Cups represents compassion, intuitive wisdom, and emotional depth guided by kindness.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Queen of Cups says your feelings are wise and sensitive, asking you to trust your empathy without drowning in it.
pathMeaning: On your path, Queen of Cups points toward emotional maturity, caring boundaries, and listening closely to intuitive truth.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Queen of Cups brings a blessing of comfort, psychic insight, and soothing emotional protection.

name: King of Cups
shortMeaning: King of Cups speaks of emotional steadiness, wisdom, and staying compassionate without losing self-control.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, King of Cups says your feelings want calm leadership, honest expression, and mature care rather than emotional overwhelm.
pathMeaning: On your path, King of Cups points toward balance, diplomacy, and leading with both heart and stability.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, King of Cups brings a blessing of peace, deep understanding, and emotional mastery.

name: Ace of Wands
shortMeaning: Ace of Wands signals fresh inspiration, creative fire, and a powerful urge to begin something exciting.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Ace of Wands says your feelings are waking up with passion, enthusiasm, and a desire to say yes to life again.
pathMeaning: On your path, Ace of Wands points toward initiative, bold beginnings, and trusting the spark that wants action now.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Ace of Wands brings a blessing of motivation, creativity, and brave new momentum.

name: Two of Wands
shortMeaning: Two of Wands represents planning, possibility, and looking beyond the familiar toward a larger future.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Two of Wands says your emotions are reaching for something bigger and asking what you truly want next.
pathMeaning: On your path, Two of Wands points toward strategy, expansion, and making a deliberate choice about where to direct your energy.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Two of Wands brings a blessing of vision, confidence, and exciting options opening outward.

name: Three of Wands
shortMeaning: Three of Wands speaks of expansion, progress, and seeing early efforts begin to reach beyond where they started.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Three of Wands says your feelings are ready to grow, trust the horizon, and believe that more is possible.
pathMeaning: On your path, Three of Wands points toward forward movement, long-range vision, and confidence that your work can travel far.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Three of Wands brings a blessing of momentum, widening opportunity, and encouraging signs from the horizon.

name: Four of Wands
shortMeaning: Four of Wands represents celebration, stability, and the happiness of a strong and welcoming foundation.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Four of Wands says your feelings want safety, joy, and a space where you can truly settle and celebrate.
pathMeaning: On your path, Four of Wands points toward milestones, supportive community, and building something that feels like home.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Four of Wands brings a blessing of harmony, festivity, and grounded happiness.

name: Five of Wands
shortMeaning: Five of Wands speaks of friction, competition, and scattered energy that needs better direction.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Five of Wands says your emotions may feel tugged in several directions, making it hard to settle into peace.
pathMeaning: On your path, Five of Wands points toward sorting priorities, navigating tension, and turning conflict into useful momentum.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Five of Wands brings a blessing of sharp awareness and the chance to grow stronger through challenge.

name: Six of Wands
shortMeaning: Six of Wands represents victory, recognition, and the confidence that comes from being seen for what you have accomplished.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Six of Wands says your feelings want encouragement, pride, and permission to own your progress.
pathMeaning: On your path, Six of Wands points toward success, visibility, and moving ahead with confidence earned through effort.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Six of Wands brings a blessing of praise, momentum, and uplifting confirmation.

name: Seven of Wands
shortMeaning: Seven of Wands speaks of perseverance, defending your ground, and staying true to your position under pressure.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Seven of Wands says your emotions want stronger self-protection and the confidence to stand by what matters.
pathMeaning: On your path, Seven of Wands points toward courage, healthy boundaries, and holding your ground without backing down too soon.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Seven of Wands brings a blessing of backbone, resilience, and support for staying true to yourself.

name: Eight of Wands
shortMeaning: Eight of Wands signals speed, movement, and events unfolding faster than they recently have.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Eight of Wands says your feelings may be moving quickly, making honesty and directness especially important.
pathMeaning: On your path, Eight of Wands points toward swift progress, fast communication, and taking advantage of open momentum.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Eight of Wands brings a blessing of acceleration, clear signals, and exciting forward motion.

name: Nine of Wands
shortMeaning: Nine of Wands represents resilience, persistence, and finding the strength to keep going near the end of a long effort.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Nine of Wands says your emotions may be tired but not finished, asking for protection and one more honest breath.
pathMeaning: On your path, Nine of Wands points toward endurance, wisdom gained through struggle, and staying alert without giving up.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Nine of Wands brings a blessing of grit, protection, and the strength to carry through.

name: Ten of Wands
shortMeaning: Ten of Wands speaks of burden, overcommitment, and carrying more than is truly yours to hold alone.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Ten of Wands says your feelings may be weighed down by pressure, responsibility, or the habit of doing too much.
pathMeaning: On your path, Ten of Wands points toward simplification, delegation, and releasing what has become too heavy to carry this way.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Ten of Wands brings a blessing of honesty about limits and the relief that comes from putting something down.

name: Page of Wands
shortMeaning: Page of Wands represents curiosity, enthusiasm, and the bright restless energy of a new adventure calling.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Page of Wands says your emotions want freedom, discovery, and the excitement of trying something fresh.
pathMeaning: On your path, Page of Wands points toward playful courage, experimentation, and following the spark before you overthink it.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Page of Wands brings a blessing of boldness, creative play, and delightful new possibilities.

name: Knight of Wands
shortMeaning: Knight of Wands speaks of bold action, passion, and charging after what lights you up.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Knight of Wands says your feelings are fiery and ready for movement, though they may need direction as much as speed.
pathMeaning: On your path, Knight of Wands points toward courage, decisive action, and trusting your drive without becoming reckless.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Knight of Wands brings a blessing of daring, charisma, and energetic forward thrust.

name: Queen of Wands
shortMeaning: Queen of Wands represents confidence, magnetism, and warm creative leadership that inspires others naturally.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Queen of Wands says your emotions want self-trust, visibility, and the courage to take up space brightly.
pathMeaning: On your path, Queen of Wands points toward bold self-expression, creative authority, and leading with warmth and assurance.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Queen of Wands brings a blessing of charm, vitality, and radiant confidence.

name: King of Wands
shortMeaning: King of Wands speaks of vision, leadership, and directing passion toward a meaningful larger purpose.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, King of Wands says your feelings want strong direction, belief in yourself, and the confidence to think big.
pathMeaning: On your path, King of Wands points toward inspired leadership, decisive movement, and acting from long-range vision.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, King of Wands brings a blessing of authority, creative fire, and the power to rally momentum around your purpose.

name: Ace of Swords
shortMeaning: Ace of Swords signals mental clarity, truth, and the clean breakthrough that cuts through confusion.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Ace of Swords says your feelings want honesty, directness, and a clearer understanding of what is really going on.
pathMeaning: On your path, Ace of Swords points toward insight, decisive thinking, and speaking the truth that changes everything.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Ace of Swords brings a blessing of sharp perception, revelation, and liberating clarity.

name: Two of Swords
shortMeaning: Two of Swords represents indecision, stalemate, and the tension of avoiding a choice that still needs to be made.
heartMeaning: In your heart position, Two of Swords says your emotions may be guarded or split, making it hard to fully admit what you know.
pathMeaning: On your path, Two of Swords points toward facing the truth, lowering defenses, and making a balanced but necessary decision.
magicMeaning: As your magic card, Two of Swords brings a blessing of discernment and the calm needed to choose with clearer eyes.
